tables.name: objective_tracking_allocator
columns: singleton_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton_id=1)
next_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(next_sequence BETWEEN 1 AND 100000000)
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
last_command_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: sequence 100000000 is exhausted sentinel and must fail before mutation
allocated MW-######## values are never reused even after hard deletion

tables.name: objectives
columns: objective_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
tracking_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(tracking_sequence BETWEEN 1 AND 99999999)
tracking_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(tracking_id)=11 AND substr(tracking_id,1,3)='MW-' AND substr(tracking_id,4) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')
creation_origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(creation_origin IN ('manual','automatic_grouping','historical_provider_complete'))
superseded_by_objective_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES objectives(objective_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
created_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at_utc>=0)
created_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
CHECK(superseded_by_objective_id IS NULL OR superseded_by_objective_id<>objective_id)
rules: tracking identity is immutable/stable and never replaced by monthly ordinal
superseded Objective remains historical with prior membership events rather than being rewritten into survivor identity

tables.name: objective_task_membership_current
columns: task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tasks(task_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
objective_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES objectives(objective_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
accepted_plan_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task_plan_revisions(plan_revision_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
membership_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(membership_revision>0)
last_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES objective_membership_events(membership_event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
rules: service verifies accepted_plan_revision belongs to task and remains a valid positive-duration accepted Task plan
one Task has at most one current Objective
current plan may later differ; mismatch is regroup input, not silent envelope rewrite

tables.name: objective_membership_events
columns: membership_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(task_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
event_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_kind IN ('add','move','remove','repin_plan','historical_add'))
from_objective_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES objectives(objective_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
to_objective_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES objectives(objective_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
accepted_plan_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task_plan_revisions(plan_revision_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
grouping_proposal_id TEXT NULL
reason_code TEXT NULL
recorded_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recorded_at_utc>=0)
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
CHECK(from_objective_id IS NOT NULL OR to_objective_id IS NOT NULL)
rules: append-only after accepted structure creation
historical membership/provenance survives current moves/removals
plan revision effective for each accepted membership event is explicit

HardDeleteObjective may delete only creation-baseline membership events for an otherwise eligible untouched manual Objective: event_kind='add', from_objective_id IS NULL, to_objective_id equals the target Objective, grouping_proposal_id IS NULL and event.command_id equals objectives.created_command_id; every current member must be represented by exactly one such baseline event and any later/nonbaseline membership event involving the Objective permanently blocks this exception

tables.name: objective_envelope_projection
columns: objective_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES objectives(objective_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
start_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(start_utc>=0)
end_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(end_utc>start_utc)
member_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(member_count>0)
membership_input_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(membership_input_fingerprint)=64)
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
rules: rebuildable from current membership pinned plan revisions
current nonsuperseded Objective must have one row
strict overlap among current accepted nonsuperseded envelopes is forbidden and transactionally revalidated

tables.name: objective_aggregate_projection
columns: objective_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES objectives(objective_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
execution_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(execution_state IN ('planned','historical_structure','in_progress','awaiting_review','reviewed','superseded'))
aggregate_outcome TEXT NULL CHECK(aggregate_outcome IS NULL OR aggregate_outcome IN ('completed','incomplete','cancelled','mixed','excluded_from_operational_counts'))
actual_start_utc INTEGER NULL CHECK(actual_start_utc IS NULL OR actual_start_utc>=0)
actual_end_utc INTEGER NULL CHECK(actual_end_utc IS NULL OR actual_end_utc>=0)
attention_reason TEXT NULL CHECK(attention_reason IS NULL OR attention_reason IN ('due_unreviewed','lost_last_executable','mixed_outcomes','plan_membership_mismatch','source_terminal_conflict'))
included_task_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(included_task_count>=0)
excluded_task_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(excluded_task_count>=0)
aggregate_input_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(aggregate_input_fingerprint)=64)
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
rules: rebuildable only from member Task execution/outcome/inclusion plus current Objective membership/supersession
historical_structure is non-executable provider-history structure and carries no actual start/end merely from source Complete
Objective start/outcome are not independently writable
lost_last_executable is set only from governed lifecycle consequence while Objective had accepted started work

tables.name: objective_review_events
columns: objective_review_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
objective_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES objectives(objective_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
review_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(review_fingerprint)=64)
derived_outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(derived_outcome IN ('completed','incomplete','cancelled','mixed','excluded_from_operational_counts'))
reviewed_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reviewed_at_utc>=0)
reason_code TEXT NULL
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
rules: append-only
reviewed_at does not create/change execution instants
current valid review is latest event whose fingerprint still matches exact current membership/outcome/inclusion inputs

tables.name: objective_archive_events
columns: archive_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
objective_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES objectives(objective_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('archive','restore'))
reason_code TEXT NULL
recorded_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recorded_at_utc>=0)
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: append-only presentation lifecycle; no Task lifecycle/membership mutation

tables.name: objective_archive_projection
columns: objective_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES objectives(objective_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
archived INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(archived IN (0,1))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
last_event_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES objective_archive_events(archive_event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: archive does not make unfinished work disappear from safety/Needs Attention projections

nonempty_rule: Every current nonsuperseded Objective has at least one objective_task_membership_current row. A manually created untouched Objective may disappear only through the explicit previewed hard-delete/last-member path; a superseded Objective may have no current members but preserves historical membership events and identity.
overlap_rule: For current nonsuperseded Objective envelopes, service commit must prove no pair satisfies a.start_utc < b.end_utc AND a.end_utc > b.start_utc. Exactly touching boundaries are permitted as separate Objectives.
